newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 25.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on March 25:
WASHINGTON - Virginia's largest utility company, Virginia Power, urged state regulators to let it increase its profits by freezing basic electric power rates for five years while it cuts its costs.
WASHINGTON - The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission sought to intervene in a gender discrimination lawsuit against Home Depot Inc.

WASHINGTON - The computer world's "Year 2000" problem -- programming errors that could make things go haywire on Jan. 1, 2000 -- is known mainly as affecting big mainframe systems, but it might be lurking in your VCR as well.
WASHINGTON - More visitors are soaking up the history of Colonial Williamsburg and lounging on the shores of Virginia Beach as a result of increased advertising spending by state tourism officials.
